name: Get Contact
description: Get a single contact from HubSpot by its id, with a default set of contact properties. Add **Additional properties to retrieve** to include more (use **Get Properties** for `contacts`). Look up the id with **Search CRM** by email if you only have an address. Example: Object ID `123`, Additional properties `["jobtitle"]`. Returns the contact record. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/contacts#endpoint?spec=GET-/crm/v3/objects/contacts/{contactId})
